title: Nonempty affine model comparison data core
statement: Let I be a preorder, R:I→CommRing a diagram, c a cocone, i∈I, Y an affine scheme [def-pc-scheme], and s:Y→Spec R(i). Assume scheme derived categories [def-pc-derived-category], t:Spec Γ(Y)≅Y, and e:D(O_Spec Γ(Y))≌D(O_Y) with a natural localization comparison he:Q⋙e.functor≅(termwise pushforward along t.hom)⋙Q. Let P,Q∈D(O_Y), and E₀,K₀ complexes of Γ(Y)-modules satisfying the native K-flat predicate [def-pc-module-kflat-complex] (equivalently, tensoring any acyclic Γ(Y)-complex with either one and totalizing yields an acyclic complex) with specified isomorphisms e.inverse(P)≅Q(tilde E₀) and e.inverse(Q)≅Q(tilde K₀). Let F be ANY diagram of rings on the upper tail, C ANY cocone, and r:Γ(Y)→F(i). Specify complexes E,K and equalities E=r*E₀ and K=r*K₀. Specify stage and limit scheme isomorphisms σ,τ whose first projections equal Spec of the r-structural ring maps followed by t, and which commute with every finite and limit base-change arrow. Specify d(j) and dlim and localization comparisons hd,hdlim identifying these derived equivalences with termwise pushforward along σ(j).hom and τ.hom, as in [lem-pc-scheme-iso-derived-equivalence]. Then affineModelComparisonData(R,c,i,Y,s,P,Q,F,C,E,K) [def-pc-affine-model-comparison-data] holds, including the four model-to-geometric-pullback isomorphisms and the two conjugated scalarExtensionHom equations [def-pc-complex-scalar-extension-hom] for the pinned perfectStageMap/perfectLimitMap [lem-pc-perfect-hom-transport]. The natural construction uses the supplied derived transports as witnesses, though the conclusion only asserts the existing existential proposition. Neither directedness, a colimit property nor a categorical pushout construction of F is needed beyond the supplied compatible scheme identifications.

source.place: Lemma 36.3.8(2), Tag 09RE affine calculation and Tag 0D5S for composition; Tag 06Y1 for scalar extension of K-flat complexes

proof.text: Substitute hEr and hKr. The native K-flat predicate implies the acyclic-tensor criterion by kFlat_quotient_obj_iff and kFlat_iff_preserves_acyclic. Apply acyclic_mapBifunctor_extendScalars_of_kFlat along r to both models.

Specialize the first stage projection equation to the bottom j₀. Normalize F.map(identity) to the identity and cancel it, giving the commuting affine square for r. Apply the single-square object comparison to E₀,P,hPE and to K₀,Q,hQK. These produce aE,aK at the bottom, with no identity scalar extension inserted.

Apply propagation from bottom models to E,K, their proved acyclic-tensor criteria, the supplied σ,τ,d,dlim,hd,hdlim, the two transition-equation families hgeom.2.2, and aE,aK. Wrap the resulting proposition in Nonempty. The separate limit first-projection equality is unused.

theorem affineBaseChangeModelIsosCore
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I]
    (R : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) (c : Cocone R)
    (i : I) (Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine Y] (s : Y ⟶ Spec (R.obj i))
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    (t : Spec (Scheme.Γ.obj (.op Y)) ≅ Y)
    (e : schemeDerivedCategory (Spec (Scheme.Γ.obj (.op Y))) ≌ schemeDerivedCategory Y)
    (he : DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ e.functor ≅
      (@Functor.mapHomologicalComplex ℤ
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (Scheme.Γ.obj (.op Y))).toRingedSpace))
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) _ _ _ _
        (SheafOfModules.pushforward t.hom.toRingCatSheafHom)
        ⟨fun _ _ ↦ rfl⟩ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q)
    (P Q : schemeDerivedCategory Y)
    (E₀ K₀ : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} (Scheme.Γ.obj (.op Y))) ℤ)
    (hE : (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso (ModuleCat.{u} (Scheme.Γ.obj (.op Y)))
      (.up ℤ)).kFlat E₀)
    (hK : (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso (ModuleCat.{u} (Scheme.Γ.obj (.op Y)))
      (.up ℤ)).kFlat K₀)
    (hPE : e.inverse.obj P ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj
      ((@Functor.mapHomologicalComplex ℤ (ModuleCat.{u} (Scheme.Γ.obj (.op Y)))
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (Scheme.Γ.obj (.op Y))).toRingedSpace))
        _ _ _ _ (@id (ModuleCat.{u} (Scheme.Γ.obj (.op Y)) ⥤
                  SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (Scheme.Γ.obj (.op Y))).toRingedSpace))
                  (tilde.functor (Scheme.Γ.obj (.op Y))))
        ⟨fun _ _ ↦ tilde.map_zero⟩ (.up ℤ)).obj E₀))
    (hQK : e.inverse.obj Q ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj
      ((@Functor.mapHomologicalComplex ℤ (ModuleCat.{u} (Scheme.Γ.obj (.op Y)))
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (Scheme.Γ.obj (.op Y))).toRingedSpace))
        _ _ _ _ (@id (ModuleCat.{u} (Scheme.Γ.obj (.op Y)) ⥤
                  SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (Scheme.Γ.obj (.op Y))).toRingedSpace))
                  (tilde.functor (Scheme.Γ.obj (.op Y))))
        ⟨fun _ _ ↦ tilde.map_zero⟩ (.up ℤ)).obj K₀))
    (F : Set.Ici i ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) (C : Cocone F)
    (r : Scheme.Γ.obj (.op Y) →+* F.obj ⟨i, le_rfl⟩)
    (E K : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} (F.obj ⟨i, le_rfl⟩)) ℤ)
    (hEr : E = ((ModuleCat.extendScalars r).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj E₀)
    (hKr : K = ((ModuleCat.extendScalars r).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj K₀)
    (σ : ∀ j : Set.Ici (⟨i, le_rfl⟩ : Set.Ici i),
      Spec (F.obj j.val) ≅ pullback s (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE j.val.property))))
    (τ : Spec C.pt ≅ pullback s (Spec.map (c.ι.app i)))
    (hgeom :
      (∀ j : Set.Ici (⟨i, le_rfl⟩ : Set.Ici i),
        (σ j).hom ≫ pullback.fst s (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE j.val.property))) =
          Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom r ≫ F.map (homOfLE j.property)) ≫ t.hom) ∧
      (τ.hom ≫ pullback.fst s (Spec.map (c.ι.app i)) =
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom r ≫ C.ι.app ⟨i, le_rfl⟩) ≫ t.hom) ∧
      (∀ (j k : Set.Ici (⟨i, le_rfl⟩ : Set.Ici i)) (hjk : j ≤ k),
        (σ k).hom ≫ baseChangeMap s
          (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE j.val.property))))
          (T' := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE k.val.property))))
          (Over.homMk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hjk)))
            (by dsimp; rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← R.map_comp]; rfl)) =
          Spec.map (F.map (homOfLE hjk)) ≫ (σ j).hom) ∧
      (∀ j : Set.Ici (⟨i, le_rfl⟩ : Set.Ici i),
        τ.hom ≫ baseChangeMap s
          (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE j.val.property))))
          (T' := Over.mk (Spec.map (c.ι.app i)))
          (Over.homMk (Spec.map (c.ι.app j.val))
            (by dsimp; rw [← Spec.map_comp, c.w (homOfLE j.val.property)])) =
          Spec.map (C.ι.app j.val) ≫ (σ j).hom))
    (d : ∀ j : Set.Ici (⟨i, le_rfl⟩ : Set.Ici i),
          schemeDerivedCategory (Spec (F.obj j.val)) ≌
            schemeDerivedCategory (pullback s (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE j.val.property)))))
      (dlim : schemeDerivedCategory (Spec (C.pt)) ≌
        schemeDerivedCategory (pullback s (Spec.map (c.ι.app i))))
    (hd : ∀ j : Set.Ici (⟨i, le_rfl⟩ : Set.Ici i),
      DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ (d j).functor ≅
      (@Functor.mapHomologicalComplex ℤ
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (F.obj j.val)).toRingedSpace))
        (SheafOfModules.{u}
          (moduleRings (pullback s (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE j.val.property)))).toRingedSpace))
        _ _ _ _
        (SheafOfModules.pushforward (σ j).hom.toRingCatSheafHom)
        ⟨fun _ _ ↦ rfl⟩ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q)
    (hdlim : DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ dlim.functor ≅
      (@Functor.mapHomologicalComplex ℤ
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec C.pt).toRingedSpace))
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (pullback s (Spec.map (c.ι.app i))).toRingedSpace)) _ _ _ _
        (SheafOfModules.pushforward τ.hom.toRingCatSheafHom)
        ⟨fun _ _ ↦ rfl⟩ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q) :
    Nonempty (affineModelComparisonData R c i Y s P Q F C E K)
